Wolverine.// CodegenMode: Auto runs Wolverine's Roslyn runtime compiler (WolverineFx.RuntimeCompilation) so the local developer inner loop needs no pre-generated handler tree and no codegen step. CI-tested builds and every published artifact omit this override and default to Static (pre-generated tree, no runtime compilation); Production is guarded to require Static. See WolverineConfiguration.ResolveTypeLoadMode.
